name: zoom-notetaker
title: Zoom notetaker
summary: Joins a Zoom meeting in a headless browser, waits out the call, and writes up the notes.
blurb: Paste a Zoom link and get minutes back — with no meeting-bot service in the loop. One tool drives a local headless Chromium into the call through Zoom's web client, rides the live-caption stream out of the DOM until the meeting ends, and the same fixed-heading prompt as meeting-notes turns what it heard into a summary, decisions, action items and open questions. The model never joins the meeting: a deterministic tool step does, and the flow branches to a plain-spoken failure end when the browser could not get in or captions were off, rather than summarizing a meeting it never heard.
